observations.statement: Yandex Games moderation usually takes 3–5 working days.
Yandex Games requires LoadingAPI.ready() to be called at the moment the user can start playing.
observations.excerpt: At the moment when the user can start playing the game, the LoadingAPI.ready() method from Game Ready must be called.

observations.statement: The total size of all game files on Yandex Games must not exceed 100 MB uncompressed.
observations.excerpt: The total size of all game files does not exceed 100 MB in uncompressed form.

observations.statement: On Yandex Games, payments are only made through the Yandex Games SDK and no external purchases are allowed.
observations.excerpt: Payments are only made through the Yandex Games SDK . There are no microtransactions or external purchases of any kind.

observations.statement: Yandex Games requires ads to be called only via its SDK, with no third-party advertisers.
observations.excerpt: Ads are only called via the Yandex Games SDK . There are no ads from third-party advertisers, including static ad images and text.

observations.statement: Yandex Games allows only sticky banners as additional ad units and prohibits custom RTB banners.
observations.excerpt: Additional ad units can only be sticky banners. Custom RTB banners are prohibited.

observations.statement: Yandex Games requires built-in automatic language detection via its SDK.
observations.excerpt: The game has built-in automatic language detection via Yandex Games SDK .

observations.statement: A Yandex game whose rating stays at 30 or below (or is absent) for 3 weeks is unpublished.
observations.excerpt: The game Rating is above 30. If the game’s rating remains at 30 or below (or is absent) for 3 weeks , it will be unpublished.
